parameters.query:
SELECT
  COALESCE(s.matricula, '') AS matricula_sessao,
  COALESCE(s.nome, '')      AS nome_sessao,
  COALESCE(s.turno, '')     AS turno_sessao,
  COALESCE(s.funcao, '')    AS funcao_sessao,
  COALESCE((s.atualizado_em > now() - interval '8 hours'), false) AS sessao_ativa
FROM (SELECT 1) AS base
LEFT JOIN public.bot_sessoes s
  ON s.session_id = $1;

SELECT
  COALESCE(q.matricula, '') AS matricula_qlp,
  COALESCE(q.nome, '')      AS nome,
  COALESCE(q.turno, '')     AS turno,
  COALESCE(q.funcao, '')    AS funcao,
  (q.matricula IS NOT NULL) AS encontrado
FROM (SELECT 1) AS base
LEFT JOIN public.qlp_ajudantes q
       ON q.matricula = $1
      AND q.ativo = true;

INSERT INTO public.bot_sessoes
  (session_id, matricula, nome, turno, funcao, atualizado_em)
VALUES
  ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, now())
ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET
  matricula     = EXCLUDED.matricula,
  nome          = EXCLUDED.nome,
  turno         = EXCLUDED.turno,
  funcao        = EXCLUDED.funcao,
  atualizado_em = now()
RETURNING session_id, matricula, nome, turno, funcao, atualizado_em;
